connector.name: Bookie
connector.registryDescription: Double-entry bookkeeping MCP server - import bank CSVs, categorize, reconcile, tax reports.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package bookie-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the yuens1002 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: BOOKIE_DB_URL
env.description: Neon pooled Postgres connection string — the ledger database

env.name: BOOKIE_DB_DIRECT_URL
env.description: Neon direct (non-pooled) Postgres connection string, used for schema push

env.name: BOOKIE_API_KEY
env.description: Static Bearer token for authenticating requests (printed by `npm run setup`)
